heading: We're building stronger local communities
paragraphs: QuickLocal was founded on a simple idea — the shops on your street should be as easy to order from as anything else on your phone, and they should keep more of what they earn.

So the platform charges vendors from 2%, guarantees riders ₹30 an order, and puts every shop through document verification before it can sell. Convenience for the customer should not come out of the seller's margin.
We are early. The catalogue is five categories and the map starts in Pune, and we would rather say so than print a number we cannot stand behind.
